prompt.text:
Implement `solution.py` with a class `SnippetTemplate`.

`SnippetTemplate(defaults=None)` stores these default options: `dialect="text"`, `open_tag=None`, `close_tag=None`, and `trim=0`. A supplied defaults mapping may replace any of those values; unknown keys raise `ValueError`. Later mutation of the supplied mapping must not affect the instance.

`render(source, overrides=None)` returns a new dictionary with keys `dialect`, `content`, and `source_span`. Unknown override keys raise `ValueError`, and neither input mapping may be mutated. `source` is split with `str.splitlines()`. If `open_tag` is not `None`, exclude the first line exactly equal to it and all preceding lines. If `close_tag` is not `None`, exclude the first matching line after the selected start and all following lines. A missing requested tag raises `ValueError`. `trim` must be a non-boolean, nonnegative integer; remove at most that many leading spaces independently from every selected line. `source_span` is the zero-based half-open range in the original split line sequence. Empty selected content is represented by `""`. `source` and `dialect` must be strings, and tags must be strings or `None`; otherwise raise `TypeError`.

All returned containers must be newly allocated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
